findings.title: Concurrent-deletion NPE remains in the other lazy-delegate accessors
findings.body: This PR null-checks the delegate in getSubGroupsCount() because modelSupplier.get() can return null when the group is deleted concurrently, but getSubGroupsStream(String,Integer,Integer) at line 256, getSubGroupsStream(Integer,Integer) at line 262, and getSubGroupsStream(String,Boolean,Integer,Integer) at line 268 all still call modelSupplier.get().<method>() unconditionally. A group deleted after its CachedGroup was loaded will therefore still throw NullPointerException through any of these paths, so the concurrent-access NPE fixed for the subgroup-count path remains reachable via the subgroup-listing paths on the same adapter.

findings.title: Reader thread is never joined, making the regression test racy and leaky
findings.body: The test starts a reader thread, deletes the groups, sets deletedAll to true at line 155, and immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty without joining the reader thread. A request already in flight when deletedAll is set can still fail (including with the original NPE, surfaced to the client as a server error) after the assertion has run, so the test can pass even without the fix. Conversely, if a delete call throws, deletedAll is never set because it is not in a finally block, so the non-daemon busy-loop thread keeps hammering the server indefinitely and can leak into subsequent tests.
